facts.text: The University of North Georgia is one of only six Senior Military Colleges in the nation and the country's only Army-exclusive senior military college.

sources.title: Cadet Admissions - University of North Georgia
sources.quote: Join America's Corps at the University of North Georgia—one of only six Senior Military Colleges in the nation and a designated State Leadership Institution.

sources.title: Cadet Admissions - University of North Georgia
sources.quote: As the nation's only Army-exclusive senior military college and The Military College of Georgia, we deliver one of the country's premier leadership development programs.
